_README: Tooth growth tables map position along the tooth (mm from cusp apex) to age at dentine formation (months after birth). Ages between knots are joined by straight lines. Cattle crown start/end ages are cited from Brown et al. (1960); everything marked TBD-LAB (crown heights, pig and horse tables) is still a placeholder. Set placeholder=false once a table is fully based on published or lab data.

tables.label: Cattle - mandibular M2
tables.source: Ages: Brown, Christofferson, Massler & Weiss 1960, Postnatal tooth development in cattle, Am. J. Vet. Res. 21:7-34 (M2 crown starts at ~1 month, complete at 12-13 months). Crown height: TBD-LAB
tables.tbd_note: Start and end ages are from Brown et al. (1960). Still needed: the crown height of unworn cattle M2 (45 mm here is a guess), whether growth is really even along the crown, and root dentine ages (samples past the crown are flagged as extrapolated).

tables.label: Cattle - mandibular M1
tables.source: End age: Brown, Christofferson, Massler & Weiss 1960, Postnatal tooth development in cattle, Am. J. Vet. Res. 21:7-34 (M1 crown starts before birth, complete at 2-3 months). Start age and crown height: TBD-LAB
tables.tbd_note: Crown completion (2.5 months) is from Brown et al. (1960). Still needed: the start age before birth (-2 months here is a guess), crown height (40 mm here is a guess) and root dentine ages.
